claims.claim_vi: gRPC: a client calls a method on a server on another machine as if it were a local object; a service is defined with the methods callable remotely, their parameters and return types; the client has a stub with the same methods.
Kubernetes is a platform for managing containerized workloads; if a container goes down another needs to start; it takes care of scaling and failover and can load balance network traffic.
OWASP OAuth2 cheat sheet: PKCE is the technique used to mitigate the authorization code interception attack on public clients using the Authorization Code Grant.
SQLite is a lightweight disk-based database needing no separate server process and can be used to prototype before porting to a larger database such as PostgreSQL.
bisect keeps a list sorted without re-sorting after each insertion and can improve on linear searches for long lists.
functools.lru_cache saves up to maxsize most recent calls and can save time when an expensive or I/O-bound function is called repeatedly with the same arguments.
Redis can be used as a database, cache, streaming engine, message broker and more.
GitHub Actions: workflows can build and test every pull request or deploy merged pull requests to production.
GitHub Copilot best practices: Copilot is not designed to replace your expertise; always validate the code it suggests and use automated tests and tooling to check it.
Measured by the author on 2026-10-19 (Python 3.13.16): bisect_left over one million sorted items with the target last calls __lt__ 20 times, against 1,000,000 elements visited by a linear scan.
claims.verified_by: Run by the author with a counting __lt__.

design_notes_vi: Bốn chuỗi bước đánh số theo mười một bước của nguồn, mỗi bước nêu một việc trong dịch vụ mượn sách, và một khung ghi nhớ. Cách chia nhóm là của bài. Không dùng ảnh nguồn.
source_deviations: The source gives each step one or two sentences with example tools; the lesson keeps only the eleven step names and their order and shows each step as a concrete task in one small project, drawn from documentation that was read.
The source's example tool lists are not repeated; the tools named are those whose documentation was read, or are marked as the author's general knowledge.
The lesson says nothing about the order being required, the time per step or what counts as senior.
editorial_note_vi: Bài mới viết trong kho này, chờ review kỹ thuật. Ví dụ dịch vụ mượn sách là minh họa tự nghĩ ra, không phải dự án thật. Chưa user testing hoặc phê duyệt phát hành.
